minimalWrittenInterface.owner: Existing packages/self-improvement EngineeringControl; no new module or generic release controller.
minimalWrittenInterface.caller: Public Toy CLI build.select operation routed through existing CLI declarations and dispatch.
minimalWrittenInterface.input: A canonical Life Store build-step identifier only. The owner derives its release tag and scope from source-bound Life Store build-plan data; caller cannot supply tags or prerequisite outcomes.
minimalWrittenInterface.output: New minimal canonical @toy/contracts LifeStoreBuildSelectionV1 containing the selected source step, derived tagged scope, proceed/blocked outcome, and public prerequisite CheckView references/results. Missing or failed actual prerequisite views block selection.
minimalWrittenInterface.behavior: Implement only Life Store selection. Bind step-to-scope mapping to the current Life Store spec digest. Preserve R1 incident-capture scope; block full-store activation until R2, recorder integration until R4, and optional pilot/auto-promotion until R5. Do not infer readiness from a step label or caller fixture flags.

finiteCases: Source-derived R0 foundation step can select only its R0 scope when actual prerequisites pass.
R1 selection retains incident-capture scope; missing/failed capture prerequisite blocks it.
Full Life Store scope remains blocked before R2 even when an earlier step is selected.
Recorder integration remains blocked before R4.
Optional pilot and auto-promotion remain blocked before R5.
